name: JoomLMS
description_en:
JoomLMS is a Joomla-based learning-management system for delivering courses, assessments and paid training. It offers on-premise installation and vendor-hosted delivery, with Standard and Professional editions.

Joomla is the underlying CMS, not a guarantee that JoomLMS has identical licensing or support. Its published license page combines a GPL statement with instance and term restrictions, so unrestricted reuse should not be inferred.
description_zh:
JoomLMS 是基于 Joomla 的学习管理系统，用于课程、考核及收费培训，提供本地安装和厂商托管，并区分 Standard 与 Professional。

Joomla 是底层 CMS，并不保证 JoomLMS 具有相同许可或支持。许可页同时包含 GPL 声明、实例和期限限制，不能据此推定无限制复用。

sections.title_zh: Joomla 课程与按版本区分的控制
sections.en: The official feature page lists SCORM 1.2/2004, AICC and LTI, learner groups, quizzes, completion reports and ecommerce. Custom roles and independent organizations are explicitly marked PRO only. The homepage separates self-managed installation from hosted deployment where the vendor handles installation and upgrades. A buyer should choose both edition and operating responsibility.
sections.zh: 功能页列出 SCORM 1.2/2004、AICC、LTI、学员组、测验、完成报告及电商，并把自定义角色和独立组织明确标为仅 PRO。首页区分自行管理安装与由厂商处理安装升级的托管部署，应同时选择版本及运营责任。

sections.title_en: Example: certify a small employee cohort
sections.title_zh: 示例：为小型员工组认证
sections.en: Create a course with imported content and a quiz, enroll a test group, then compare completion, attempt limits and the certificate with expected rules. Pilot a failed attempt and a resumed quiz as well as a successful learner. If selling access, separately test payment-to-enrollment behavior. These are suggested checks, not evidence that any particular plugin combination works.
sections.zh: 创建包含导入内容和测验的课程，登记测试组，对照预期规则检查完成、尝试次数及证书。除成功路径外，也应试点失败和恢复测验。若销售访问权，另测支付到选课链路。本例是建议检查，不证明具体插件组合可用。

sections.title_en: Hosted, perpetual and maintenance are distinct
sections.title_zh: 托管、永久许可及维护需区分
sections.en: The purchase page offers a 30-day trial and paid Standard/Professional choices. Much of the calculator remained unresolved template expressions, so no cash starting amount is retained. The FAQ distinguishes yearly and perpetual licenses and says maintenance is optional for continued updates. It also says separate domains need separate licenses and customization/source changes require Professional. Confirm current price, user cap, term, support and upgrade rights in writing.
sections.zh: 购买页提供 30 天试用及付费 Standard/Professional。计算器大量内容仍为未解析模板表达式，因此不保留现金起价。FAQ 区分年度和永久许可，说明持续更新的维护费用可选；独立域名需另购许可，定制及源码修改需要 Professional。应书面确认当前价格、人数上限、期限、支持及升级权。

sections.en: The license page says the software is delivered under GPL version 2, but also describes one live installation, yearly versus perpetual use and redistribution restrictions. This profile reports that inconsistency without resolving legal enforceability or classifying the whole product as unrestricted open source. Review the actual purchased package and terms before reuse. Installation requirements, current Joomla compatibility and restoration were not tested.
sections.zh: 许可页称软件采用 GPL v2，又规定一个生产实例、年度及永久使用及再分发限制。本文保留不一致，不判断法律效力，也不把整个产品归为无限制开源。复用前需检查实际购买包及条款。安装要求、当前 Joomla 兼容性与恢复未测试。
